title: Economy lab
intro: Charts read the building catalogue live, so they follow BuildingCatalogue.cs without edits here.

curves.title: Curves
curves.empty: Select at least one building type.
curves.note: Solid lines are the live catalogue, dashed lines the what-if catalogue.

unlocks.title: Unlock ladder
unlocks.hint: New buildings per Longhouse level. Target is roughly one per level.

pacing.title: Pacing
pacing.hint: One settlement, no terrain boosts, greedy player: Longhouse when the starting producers are as far ahead as the strategy allows, storage when the next Longhouse or producer level no longer fits, else the best-payback producer upgrade (also while saving for the Longhouse, if it pays back before then). Every tower the Longhouse allows adds one more producer of each type. The Town Square and the Cart Workshop are built and paid for like any building. A profile is a list of daily sessions; the player only acts inside them. Every result shows the live catalogue and the what-if catalogue side by side.
pacing.producersPerTower: Producers of each type per tower
pacing.chartTitle: Longhouse level over time (solid live, dashed what-if)
pacing.renownNote: Renown needed for the 2nd settlement; the live game uses 80 000 (doubling per further settlement).

whatIf.title: What-if
whatIf.hint: Every level of every building is regenerated from its level-1 values and these growth factors. The defaults reproduce the live catalogue. Curves update at once; the simulation runs on Run.
